title: MOVING2024: Motor imagery / motor execution dataset from the MOVING study
description: A multi-modal dataset of 32-channel dry EEG recorded together with Virtual Glove hand-kinematic tracking during motor imagery and motor execution of three right-hand movements (open/close, wrist rotation, finger tapping). Eleven healthy participants completed rest, motor imagery and motor execution triplets with eight repetitions each. This BIDS release was produced via MOABB for benchmarking brain-computer interface approaches.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a Neuroelectrics Enobio 32 wireless dry-electrode system at 500 Hz (32 EEG channels plus 3 miscellaneous channels, 10-20 montage, CMS/DRL reference). Each participant performed a rest, motor imagery, motor execution triplet for three right-hand movements, with visual cues, 8 repetitions, and 6 s trials, in a single session of about 10 minutes.
